OUTSIDE_HOURS.title: Call outside 08:00-19:00
OUTSIDE_HOURS.rule: Borrowers may be contacted only between 08:00 and 19:00 unless they expressly asked for another time.

NO_RECORDING_DISCLOSURE.title: Recording not disclosed
NO_RECORDING_DISCLOSURE.rule: Recovery calls must be recorded and the borrower told that the conversation is being recorded.

THREAT_OR_ABUSE.title: Threat or abusive language
THREAT_OR_ABUSE.rule: No minatory or abusive language, threatening calls, or threat of violence to person, family, assets or reputation.

WRONG_DUES.title: Dues misstated
WRONG_DUES.rule: No false or misleading representation about the amount of the debt.

THIRD_PARTY.title: Relatives / employer / public shaming
THIRD_PARTY.rule: Dues are discussed only with the borrower. No harassing relatives, referees, friends or co-workers, no public humiliation.

IGNORED_SENSITIVE_SITUATION.title: Pressed during bereavement / calamity / wedding
IGNORED_SENSITIVE_SITUATION.rule: Avoid inappropriate occasions such as bereavement, other calamitous occasions or marriage functions.
